title: Qualify the MRF pilot and author pricing research examples
objective: MRF discovery has demonstrated research tasks and an honest pilot coverage report.
outcome: Hospital and payer walkthroughs use official fictional CMS examples labeled synthetic, with receipts for executed steps. Frozen 25 hospital and 10 payer IDs remain the denominator; locators are not materialized and unknown cells cannot count as supported. Failed targets stay blockers with bounded follow-up tasks; difficult cohort members are not replaced. An implementer or model cannot approve its own scientific output. A reviewer can reproduce the pricing task without mistaking a rate for observed payment or a legal-compliance judgment. All twelve expansion families have documented routes. Last-good generation live-2026-09-03-85b50522b420 is unchanged.

commits.subject: Write hospital and payer walkthroughs
commits.instructions: Use one qualified example of each to explain locating a file, inspecting schema, finding a code/rate, resolving references and identifying non-comparable dimensions.
commits.verification: Every example operation links to its exact sample/metadata receipt; real and fictional examples are explicitly labeled.

commits.subject: Reconcile pilot acceptance
commits.instructions: Check 25 hospital/10 payer dispositions and at least 20/eight successful bounded parsed samples. Report reasons for failures and limits of geographic/market representation.
commits.verification: A failed target stays a blocker with a bounded follow-up task; do not replace difficult cohort members.

commits.subject: Publish the pricing methods and coverage packet
commits.instructions: Explain historical/current schemas, sampling bias, stale rates, duplicate/shared files, missing references, price definitions and citations. Confirm all twelve expansion families also have routes.
commits.verification: A reviewer can reproduce the pricing task without mistaking a rate for observed payment or a legal-compliance judgment.
